subject: Mediknow — security intake: SIG/CAIQ selection & clarifying asks
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@mediknow.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Mediknow discovery recap + next steps on security intake

Hi Samir / Julie —

Quick recap from today's demo + discovery call and the asks I captured on security/compliance: 

- SGD status: you mentioned SOC 2 in-progress (Controls implemented, Type I targeted this quarter). Can you confirm the audit firm and expected Type II window?
- Data classification: primary payloads will be PHI + PII (sensitive patient notes). You flagged HIPAA compliance as a hard requirement.
- Hosting / residency: US-only initially, with EU later (potentially Q4).
- Questionnaire: you asked whether we prefer SIG (OpenSSF CAIQ) vs CAIQ vs a custom form.

Requested next steps (proposed):
1) Samir / Julie: confirm SOC 2 auditor and estimated Type II date; confirm whether you need Redwood to sign a BAA or just the standard DPA for pilot.
2) Redwood security (Karthik): provide a short SOC 2 status summary and suggested path (SIG prefill vs CAIQ) + list of documents we can deliver quickly.
3) I'll send a prefill template for SIG so you can see the level of effort and we can agree on timeline for delivering evidence.

I attached a short two-page SOC2 summary we can share with procurement; Karthik will follow up on the SIG/CAIQ recommendation.

Thanks — high-level next meeting: propose Wed 6/30 10am PT for procurement/security sync if that works.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@mediknow.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Julie Dowell <julie.dowell@mediknow.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mediknow discovery recap + next steps on security intake

Thanks Vivek — useful recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: our security team is running the audit with LumenAudit. We completed readiness in May; plan to pursue Type I in July, Type II in January 2028. We will need an internal SOC 2 summary for procurement.
- BAA: for the pilot we'll need a signed BAA because of PHI, yes. Prep-docs should assume HIPAA controls.
- SIG vs CAIQ: procurement typically prefers SIG prefill for speed; our security lead (Julie) will still kick the answers back to their bench but SIG lets us compare more quickly.
- Evidence: we can receive prefilled SIG spreadsheet but would prefer a short list of 6–8 high-priority artifacts to avoid chasing a long list (e.g., encryption at rest key mgmt, BAA, incident response runbook, KMS ownership, VPC data flow diagram, data retention policy).

Can you also confirm: does Redwood host in single-tenant per-customer pools for Dedicated, or is data still co-located? That will determine whether we need a formal data flow diagram for the pilot.

Samir
Director, IT Security
Mediknow
samir.khan@mediknow.com | +1 617-555-0199
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@mediknow.com>, Julie Dowell <julie.dowell@mediknow.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mediknow discovery recap + next steps on security intake

Hi Samir / Julie —

Thanks — good detail. Short answers and clarification requests from Redwood security: 

1) Hosting model: for the hosted API we run multi-tenant clusters logically isolated; Dedicated provides tenant-isolated GPU pools with network-level separation (recommended for PHI/BAA). For the pilot (short-term) many customers accept Hosted + encryption + contractual BAA; for production we typically recommend Dedicated.

2) SIG vs CAIQ: SIG (OpenSSF/CAIQ-style) works fine for procurement. We usually provide a prefill that answers 60–75% of questions and then supply a smaller evidence bundle. We'll attach our prefill template and a proposed 'evidence shortlist' — please see the attached prefill template (Mediknow_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx) and our suggested minimal evidence set.

3) Evidence shortlist (priority for pilot):
- Signed BAA (we can start the BAA draft)
- SOC 2 summary + controls mapping (see redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- KMS / encryption at rest architecture diagram + authority (AWS KMS customer-managed or Redwood-managed options)
- Network/VPC data flow diagram for Dedicated; for Hosted we will provide a tenancy/data flow note
- Incident response runbook excerpt and contact for security escalation
- Data retention policy and deletion/retention SLAs

4) Small ask: can you share a short list (one paragraph each) of your regulatory constraints (e.g., which data elements are PHI under your workflows) so we can map controls precisely? Also please confirm whether pilot requires Dedicated or if Hosted under BAA is acceptable for 30–90 day pilot.

Next steps I propose: I will prep the SIG prefill and the 6-item evidence bundle for intake and share via Drive. Vivek / Monica — can we schedule a 30-min intake with Samir and procurement on Wed 6/30 10am PT?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: Mediknow_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx
